Thing.label: Thing
Thing.description: The most generic type of item.

FAQPage.label: FAQPage
FAQPage.description: A FAQPage is a WebPage presenting one or more Frequently asked questions.

Article.label: Article
Article.description: An article, such as a news article or piece of investigative report.

Organization.label: Organization
Organization.description: An organization such as a school, NGO, corporation, club, etc.

LocalBusiness.label: LocalBusiness
LocalBusiness.description: A particular physical business or branch of an organization.

Person.label: Person
Person.description: A person (alive, dead, undead, or fictional).

Event.label: Event
Event.description: An event happening at a certain time and location.

WebSite.label: WebSite
WebSite.description: A WebSite is a set of related web pages and other items typically served from a single web domain.

BreadcrumbList.label: BreadcrumbList
BreadcrumbList.description: A BreadcrumbList is an ItemList consisting of a chain of linked Web pages.

JobPosting.label: JobPosting
JobPosting.description: A listing that describes a job opening in a certain organization.

identifier.label: Identifier
identifier.description: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier.

sameAs.label: Same As
sameAs.description: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity.

dateModified.label: Date Modified
dateModified.description: The date on which the CreativeWork was most recently modified.

publisher.label: Publisher
publisher.description: The publisher of the creative work.

keywords.label: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords or tags used to describe this content.

inLanguage.label: In Language
inLanguage.description: The language of the content or performance.

breadcrumb.label: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: A set of links that can help a user understand and navigate a website hierarchy.

mainEntity.label: Main Entity
mainEntity.description: Indicates the primary entity described in some page or other CreativeWork.

openingHours.label: Opening Hours
openingHours.description: The general opening hours for a business. Opening hours can be specified as a weekly time range.

startDate.label: Start Date
startDate.description: The start date and time of the item.

endDate.label: End Date
endDate.description: The end date and time of the item.

location.label: Location
location.description: The location of, for example, where an event is happening.

jobTitle.label: Job Title
jobTitle.description: The job title of the person.

worksFor.label: Works For
worksFor.description: Organizations that the person works for.

itemListElement.label: Item List Element
itemListElement.description: For itemListElement values, you can use Simple values such as 'Peter', 'Paul', and 'Mary', Zip codes such as '98052', or Simple tuples such as (1,1) = 1 gadget.

offers.label: Offers
offers.description: An offer to provide this item.

aggregateRating.label: Aggregate Rating
aggregateRating.description: The overall rating, based on a collection of reviews or ratings, of the item.

employmentType.label: Employment Type
employmentType.description: Type of employment (e.g. full-time, part-time, contract, temporary, seasonal, internship).

validThrough.label: Valid Through
validThrough.description: The date after which the item is not valid.

datePosted.label: Date Posted
datePosted.description: Publication date of an online listing.

responsibilities.label: Responsibilities
responsibilities.description: Responsibilities associated with this role or Occupation.

directApply.label: Direct Apply
directApply.description: Indicates whether an url that is associated with a JobPosting enables direct application to the job.

jobLocation.label: Job Location
jobLocation.description: A (typically single) geographic location associated with the job position.

numberOfItems.label: Number Of Items
numberOfItems.description: The number of items in an ItemList.
